partial.label: Thin cover (rule only; the estimate has no partial class)

method.model: none: NDVI threshold rule (estimate), not machine learning
method.observations: backend/field calendar.json observations (Sentinel-2 L2A and Landsat C2 L2)
method.daily_fill: nearest observation within gaps <= 30 days; longer gaps unknown
method.markers: green_up = first of 3 covered after bare/water; senescence_harvest = first of 2 non-covered after cover; cutting = cover back within 45 days
method.note: Estimated from the rule-based S2/Landsat calendar (backend/field calendar.json): no machine-learning model was run on this BC field (the California models were trained on Kings and Colusa). Two classes plus water: NDVI >= 0.275 covered, else bare (the rule's 0.20/0.35 thresholds split at their midpoint, so it has no thin-cover class); 3-observation centred mode; gaps <= 30 days filled from the nearest observation, longer gaps unknown.

sources.title: USGS NDVI, the foundation for remote sensing phenology
